Sound Savage AI is a ruthless, high-performance, AI-powered artist engine and music label that replaces every broken part of the industry with machines, creativity, and pure grind.  From beat creation to full-length video production, it’s built to coach, test, evolve, and sign the strongest underground artists — no fluff, no participation trophies.   ---  🧱 USER PROGRESSION SYSTEM  Ranks:  1. Newbie Lyricist   2. Technical Lyricist   3. Master Lyricist   4. Fire Lyricist    You climb by:  Submitting verses  Winning battles  Climbing Reaper Radio rankings  Unlocking new features    ---  🛠️ FULL AI TOOL LINEUP   ---  1. Reaper Beat Forage Custom beat generator. User picks genre, BPM, mood (aggressive, chill, trap, etc.) AI instantly generates a unique beat.   ---  2. Ghostwriter Booth + AI Coach Write your bars and get coached by the Reaper AI. Choose your vibe: Ruthless, Pain, Savage, Heartbreak AI grades your structure, delivery, and wordplay.   ---  3. Battle The Reaper Face off against the bot. Bot drops 8 bars first — you respond with your own. AI judge decides the winner — no bias, no favors.   ---  4. Reaper Flow Forage Train cadence, rhythm, breath control. AI analyzes timing and shows where to tighten up. Built to make amateurs sound elite.   ---  5. Full Song Construction + Coaching Put together a complete track: Hook → Verse → Chorus AI helps with structure, pacing, delivery tone, and polish. Final song can be submitted to Reaper Radio.   ---  6. Reaper Radio (Weekly Competition) Top 100 → 50 → 25 → 10 → Final 5 every week Real users vote — no fake accounts Top 5 get access to music video and featured artist tools.   ---  7. Featured Artist Generator Lock in your artist identity. Create your name, voice, style, image, brand. Learn how to market, build merch, and roll out your career.   ---  8. Interactive AI Music Video Generator Generate a full-length high-quality video. Use your AI avatar and/or voice clone Choose scenes (barn, bar, graveyard, trailer, woods, etc.) Elite visuals. Affordable access. Full export included.   ---  9. The Reaper Vault Exclusive toolset only unlocked by high-ranking users. Includes unreleased verses, rare beats, deleted content, and high-end music tools.   ---  🔐 SECURITY & ANTI-FAKE FEATURES  • Must be 18+ to join (DOB required) • Email, artist name, and label required • 7-day free trial, then subscription (weekly, monthly, annual) • One device = one vote = one user • No fake plays, no inflated stats, no cheating • Only paid users can vote or compete in battles   ---  💰 MONETIZATION MODEL  • One-week free trial • Subscription options: – Weekly: $7.99 – Monthly: $19.99 – Annual: $149 • Payments via Stripe or PayPal • AI tools limited after trial unless subscribed • Vault, battles, and Reaper Radio entry require subscription or rank   ---  🧠 THE MISSION  To replace traditional record labels with an AI-powered, creator-owned, battle-hardened system that builds real careers based on skill — not clout.
